look_here_first: Inspect the intact papery spathe: normally 2–3 bracts, about one vein each. The umbel usually bears 10–25 flowers; bulbils are rare.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Basal linear leaves 10–30 cm long, 1–3(–5) mm wide.

key_traits.label: Umbel
key_traits.text: Mostly 10–25 flowers on 5–20 mm pedicels; bulbils rare.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Six spreading tepals; campanulate to star-like flowers about 6–9 mm.
